parole.significato: A spicy pepper sauce made from tabasco pepper (a chili pepper) with the addition of vinegar and salt.
parole.testo: Of unclear origin. The first definition listed in the 1994 Diccionario enciclopédico de Tabasco was from the Nahuatl name of the area, tlapalco meaning "(place of) damp earth"; wetlands are still extensive in the Mexican state of Tabasco.
